title: Decide with Jev: Laravel AI That Answers with a Probability
content:
Decide with Jev is a new mini course where we build an app that checks if a draft does what its brief asked for. It uses Jev, an AI model from TypeSafe that answers with a number instead of text. In episode 1 we set it up and test it: a complete draft scores 0.96, and a thin one scores 0.02.

The post Decide with Jev: Laravel AI That Answers with a Probability appeared first on Laravel News.
